experiment_data.hypothesis: Vanilla baseline on libero_object benchmark (seed 42): No OCC head, no auxiliary task. Establishes cross-benchmark baseline to test whether gradient flow × norm_type interaction generalizes beyond libero_spatial. If spatial-only results hold on object suite, strengthens generalizability claim.
